methods.label: SSS and equal supplementary angles
methods.explanation: By SSS, \(\triangle ABD\cong\triangle ACD\), so \(\angle ADB=\angle ADC\). Also, \(\angle ADB+\angle ADC=180^\circ\), hence \(\angle ADB=90^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: SSS, corresponding angles, and adjacent supplementary angles are within Grade 8 geometry.

methods.label: Use the isosceles median property
methods.explanation: Since \(AB=AC\), the triangle is isosceles with base \(BC\). Because \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), \(AD\) is the median to the base. In an isosceles triangle, this median is also an altitude, so \(AD\perp BC\). Therefore \(\angle ADB=90^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: This uses the standard Grade 8 property that the base median of an isosceles triangle is an altitude.
